video.title: WTF is SERVERLESS? Benefits and Usecase #devops #serverless #cloudcomputing

transcript.text: what is serverless does that mean no
servers at all let me explain you so
serverless Computing is a way of
building and running your applications
without you worrying about any
infrastructure so there are servers and
serverless but you don't have to manage
them instead the cloud provider is going
to manage it for you and allocate
resources automatically when you run
your application serverless is often
used for applications that are event
driven and have unpredictable workloads
and you're only charged for the actual
usage which means you save money when
using serverless using serverless
developers focus on writing the code for
the application rather than managing the
infrastructure some popular serverless
services are Lambda API Gateway dynamodb
Google Cloud functions and much more
